scope: Fresh Yggdrasil shadow forecasting and continued native/four-head synthetic training. No model promotion.
hypothesis: One explicit identity hypothesis and one fitted history-conditioned alternative can protect return and unsupported-law forecasts while structural transfer is still competitive on independent draws.
model: Identity, template marginal, and fitted history-conditioned change-point model start at [1/2,1/4,1/4] probability. Update by forecast likelihood after each witnessed transition. Hard use at >=0.9 posterior; Bayesian marginal below. No candidate weights are written into the native learner.
controls: Native pinned, continuously updated native, fully fitted conditional Beta with identical open-set gate, original native template marginal, and fitted history-conditioned change-point. All receive the same actual intervention and observed public history. Source rules, seed, oracle outcome and hidden states never passed to any predictor.
evaluation: On each of 3 fresh seeds and each target stage, retain frozen margins from the first structurally guided comparison. Beat strongest matched control by 0.005 on the represented transform. Stay within 0.02 of pinned familiar performance and within 0.02 of the strongest fitted or live control on the unsupported lag structure.
stop: This is the one planned open-set follow-up on disjoint cohorts. Any prespecified criterion miss closes this short line without retuning or altering thresholds. Unprotected synthetic development only.
